capability.environment: Arena.ai agent sandbox: Node 22 renderer with @napi-rs/canvas and sharp, FFmpeg 9.0.2 and ffprobe for encoding and frame/audio inspection, image viewing tools for still-frame review

reviewer.method: Decoded the entire preview.mp4 at 2 fps into a 33-frame mosaic covering 0-16.4s and inspected it visually; inspected per-shot start/mid/end PNG evidence stills and the preview contact sheet; extracted and viewed baseline frames of approved-2026-10-23.mp4 at 1s, 6s, 12s and 18s; measured audio with ffmpeg volumedetect on both preview (mean -18.9 dB, max -1.3 dB) and baseline (mean -21.4 dB, max -1.7 dB); read preview.srt caption timings against project captions

limits: Hashes, decoded artifacts and complete coverage establish current-media provenance, not aesthetic equivalence.
Reviewer identity, independence, actual viewing/listening and capability limitations are declarations, not authenticated facts.
Independent agent review does not imply human approval or user acceptance.
Sample-target review compares the available approved examples, not identical plots, voices, pixels or unavailable originals.

B3 endpoint geometry and authored intentions are diagnostics. Each graphic and motion event still needs actual-MP4 independent review; wrong relationships and meaningless motion cannot receive a limited-capability waiver.
The complete approved Full V4 film is unavailable in this bundle; only sampled long-form compositions are comparable.

note: Smoke-test of bundled B1 example adapted with motion metadata; preview inspected frame-by-frame, audio measured, compared against Ryan V4 baseline
